patchGroups.groupName: STARPHONIC Bubinga 14x6 sourced shell and hardware completion

updates.hardware.snareThrowMakeAndModel: Linear-Drive Strainer / STARPHONIC strainer system with detachable butt plate
updates.notes.scoringBasis: Official Tama STARPHONIC Bubinga page confirms Bubinga shell, Cordia outer ply language, Grooved Hoop, and thinner-shell design. Reputable dealer listings support 7mm, 8-ply Bubinga + 1 outer ply Cordia, Linear-Drive Strainer, detachable butt plate, and 20-strand Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snare Wires. Stock heads and snare bed type remain unconfirmed from official source.

updates.hardware.snareThrowMakeAndModel: Linear-Drive Strainer / STARPHONIC strainer system with detachable butt plate
updates.notes.scoringBasis: Official Tama STARPHONIC Maple page confirms the Maple model, Grooved Hoop, and Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snappy language. Reputable dealer listings support 6mm, 6-ply Maple + 1 outer ply Mappa Burl, Linear-Drive Strainer, detachable butt plate, and 20-strand Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snare Wires. Stock heads and snare bed type remain unconfirmed from official source.

Official Tama STARPHONIC Spruce page confirms the Spruce model. Reputable dealer listings identify the throw-off and butt as Linear-Drive Strainer and Butt Plate, with MLS50A / MLS50B part references. Stock heads, bearing edge, and snare bed type remain unconfirmed from official source.
